sampleContent: By Scott WalkerScott Walker, a Republican, was governor of Wisconsin from 2011 to 2019.If Texas Republicans want to win their fight with runaway Democrats, there is a playbook. We wrote it in Wisconsin in 2011.That February, 14 Democrats in the Wisconsin Senate crossed over the state line to avoid a vote on major, long-overdue reforms that Republican lawmakers and I were determined to enact. I proposed transferring power from Big Government union bosses back into the hands of hardworking taxpayers and those they elect to run their state and local governments.AdvertisementAdvertisementAdvertisementAdvertisementAs the Democrats left, protesters poured into the state. Eventually, as many as 100,000 took over our Capitol and square for nearly a month. The Occupy movement did not begin on Wall Street.
